description: MST Bus Stops is a dataset listed in City of Salinas Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Monterey-Salinas Transit. This dataset is directly derived from Monterey-Salinas Transit GIS data, available at. The geometry, locations, and attribute information of the features in this dataset are all created by and provided by MST, and no direct edits or modifications are made by City of Salinas GIS Staff. Coverage: Salinas, California. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are Bus Stops, Bus, MST, Monterey County, City of Salinas. The portal shows 930 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cityofsalinas-portal.
